title: Unified AIAS Development Platform
purpose: Expose verified AEPS generations through one governed, specification-driven and evidence-producing production boundary.
scope: Stable job/result contracts, isolated workspaces, least-complex engine selection, V3/V4/V5 adapters, normalized evidence, lifecycle events and tamper-evident records.

requirements.title: Unified contract
requirements.statement: Development jobs and results shall remain stable across AEPS engine generations.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Governed selection
requirements.statement: The platform shall select the least complex capable engine or honor an explicit supported mode.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Safety boundary
requirements.statement: Every run shall require specification identity, correlation and a workspace below the allowed root.
requirements.rationale: Prevent ambiguous or unsafe production runs.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Evidence normalization
requirements.statement: Every engine result shall expose certification, artifacts and tamper-evident normalized evidence.
requirements.rationale: Maintain a comparable development golden thread.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: The real AEPS V3 engine shall execute and certify a specification through the unified platform.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: The platform shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
requirements.rationale: Keep the development control plane deployable.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
